description: Dependency updates, grouped so each ecosystem arrives as one merge request, on Mondays (UTC); security fixes at any time. Renovate runs from the `renovate` job in .gitlab-ci.yml on the project's daily pipeline schedule.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A dependency with a known vulnerability (OSV database) gets its fix as soon as the scheduled pipeline next runs, not on Mondays only, and labelled so it stands out.

packageRules.description: Rust crates, as one merge request.
The web app's npm packages, as one merge request.
The GitHub mirror's workflow actions, kept pinned to full commit SHAs.
Container images: CI jobs, the Dockerfile and the Compose files.
Rust is raised by hand, in rust-toolchain.toml, the Dockerfile, .gitlab-ci.yml, ci.yml and Cargo.toml together (ADR 0007).
A Postgres major can't read the previous major's data directory, so it needs pg_upgrade or a dump and restore: raised by hand, with a plan, in the Compose files and both CI configs together.

A TypeScript major waits until every tool that depends on TypeScript accepts it: the scheduled `typescript watch` job opens an issue when they do, and approving the update on the Dependency Dashboard then opens its merge request.
